description: Native time field with labels, constraints, picker access, and clearing.

attributes.name: clearable
attributes.description: Shows an embedded clear button while the field has a value.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the field and its action buttons.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible label associated with the native time input.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name submitted with the containing form; defaults to the initial inline content when omitted.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Hint forwarded to the native input; browsers may ignore it for date and time controls.

methods.name: clear(): void
methods.description: Clears the selected time and emits `input`, `change`, and `tp-clear`.

methods.name: showPicker(): void
methods.description: Opens the native time picker when supported by the browser.

events.name: change
events.description: Emitted when the selected time is committed.

events.name: input
events.description: Emitted when the selected time changes while editing.

events.name: tp-clear
events.description: Emitted after the embedded button clears the value.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-timefield>` element implements the <tp-icon name="timefield" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Time field functionality: native time field with labels, constraints, picker access, and clearing.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Using the component | Type a time or use the browser's time controls. |
| Using the component | The display follows your locale. |
| Using the component | Use the clear control when available to remove the selected time. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Move between the available controls. |
| Typing | Enter or edit the value using the field controls; read-only and disabled fields cannot be edited. |
| Enter / Space on Clear | Activate the clear button when available. |
| Ctrl+? | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include Shift if needed to type ?. |
